releases.notes:
Hotfix for Blue Client 1.4.12: the client brand (shown on the F3 screen, sent to servers and written into crash reports) is now "Blue Client Fabric", "Blue Client Quilt", "Blue Client Forge" or "Blue Client NeoForge", depending on your loader.

Builds are attached for every supported loader and Minecraft version:
- Fabric and Quilt: 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.4, 1.21.7, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3, 26.4
- Forge: 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.4, 1.21.7, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3, and 1.8.9
- NeoForge: 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.4, 1.21.7, 1.21.11, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3

Fabric and Quilt need Fabric API (Quilted Fabric API on Quilt). Use the jar that matches your Minecraft version and loader. These standalone jars update themselves; the Blue Client launcher keeps its own copy up to date.

Source: https://github.com/blairdash/blue-client

releases.notes:
Blue Client 1.4.12 for Minecraft Java Edition.

Builds are attached for every supported loader and Minecraft version:
- Fabric and Quilt: 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.4, 1.21.7, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3, 26.4
- Forge: 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.4, 1.21.7, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3, and 1.8.9
- NeoForge: 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.4, 1.21.7, 1.21.11, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3

Fabric and Quilt need Fabric API (Quilted Fabric API on Quilt). Use the jar that matches your Minecraft version and loader. These standalone jars update themselves; the Blue Client launcher keeps its own copy up to date.

Source: https://github.com/blairdash/blue-client

mods.name: Blue Client
mods.description: Blue Client for every supported Minecraft version in a single jar.

releases.notes:
- Waypoints: markers no longer jitter when you move the camera, and singleplayer waypoints are now saved per world
- Waypoints menu (K), named waypoints, colours and world markers
- Saturation now matches AppleSkin: gold rim icons, flashing hunger/health previews, exhaustion underlay, estimated health overlay and food values in item tooltips (each one can be turned off in the Saturation settings)
- New "Use Minecraft GUI" option in Settings
- Every Blue Client key gets a default key automatically
- Freelook defaults to Left Alt
- New pink rank icon

- Food tooltip now uses AppleSkin-style hunger and saturation icons
- Shulker Preview rebuilt as a slot grid in the item tooltip (replaces the text list)
- Saturation's health-restore hearts now use the real heart textures from your resource pack

mods.name: Blue Client
mods.description: Blue Client for every supported Minecraft version in a single jar.

releases.notes:
New Blue Client icon everywhere. Launcher 1.1.6, mod 1.4.5.
- Rank icons use the app icon (gold for content creators, cyan for developers)
- Launcher sets its taskbar icon explicitly so the old icon no longer sticks
- Click GUI: smaller BLUE CLIENT title with the gradient logo

releases.notes:
New Blue Client icon (gradient) in the launcher, mod and website. Launcher 1.1.5, mod 1.4.4.
- Gradient logo in the launcher top bar, update splash and rank chip
- Click GUI: smaller BLUE CLIENT title, gradient logo
- Rank icon now has a gradient

mods.name: Blue Client
mods.description: Blue Client for every supported Minecraft version in a single jar.

releases.notes:
Launcher 1.1.4: the Mods tab now lists every mod in your mods folder, including jars you added by hand (marked "added manually"). Each mod shows its real name, author, version and icon, read from the jar, and large icons are supported. Manual jars can be enabled, disabled and removed too.

The Fabric mod (all supported Minecraft versions in blueclient-all.jar) and the Forge 1.8.9 build are unchanged from 1.4.3.

mods.name: Blue Client
mods.description: Blue Client for every supported Minecraft version in a single jar.

releases.notes:
Launcher 1.1.3: the launcher now checks for updates before it opens. If a newer launcher exists it updates automatically and relaunches; if there is none (or you're offline) it opens right away.

The Fabric mod (all supported Minecraft versions in blueclient-all.jar) and the Forge 1.8.9 build are unchanged from 1.4.3.

mods.description: Blue Client for every supported Minecraft version in a single jar.

releases.notes: Blue Client 1.4.3. blueclient-all.jar covers Fabric 1.20.1 through 26.4; blueclient-1.4.3-1.8.9.jar is the Forge 1.8.9 build. Launcher installer carried over from the previous release.

- Launcher 1.1.1: versions are no longer grouped in the version picker.
- Blue Client for Minecraft 1.8.9 (Forge) is now version 1.4.1, and the launcher always gives 1.8.9 its own Forge jar.
- Other Minecraft versions are unchanged and still use `blueclient-all.jar` from v1.4.1.
